name: Notion

verdict.headline: OAuth works for any Notion workspace as soon as you create a public connection, with no review; only the optional Marketplace listing is reviewed (5 to 10 business days).
verdict.nextAction: Decide between "Any workspace" and "Selected workspaces only" before you create the connection in the Developer portal, because the scope can't be changed afterwards.

appType: Public connection (OAuth). Notion now calls integrations "connections"; they are managed in the Developer portal (app.notion.com/developers), launched 2026-05-12. There are no OAuth scopes: you choose capabilities on the connection.

beforeApproval.item: Without any review, a connection with the "Any workspace" scope can be authorised by any Notion user in any workspace.
beforeApproval.detail: Listing is optional, and an unlisted connection still works through OAuth.

beforeApproval.item: "Selected workspaces only" limits installs to workspaces you choose, and those connections can never be listed.

prerequisites.item: A Notion account and a development workspace

prerequisites.detail: "Any workspace" or "Selected workspaces only". It can't be changed after creation.

prerequisites.item: For a listing: name, description, category, tags, images and logo
prerequisites.detail: Listing also requires a connection with the "Any workspace" scope.

steps.title: Create a public connection
steps.detail: Open Developer portal > Build > Public connections > Create new connection.

steps.title: Enter connection details
steps.detail: Enter the name, dev workspace, redirect URIs, installation scope and capabilities. The installation scope can't be changed later. Capabilities: Content (read, update, insert), Comments (read, insert), User info (none, without email, or with email).
steps.agentHelp: Can map your app's features to the minimum capabilities needed and lay out the "Any workspace" vs "Selected workspaces only" trade-off for your decision.

steps.title: Store the client ID and secret
steps.detail: Copy the OAuth client ID and secret from the Configuration tab into a secret store.
steps.agentHelp: Can wire the app's config to read the client ID and secret from the secret store once you add them.

steps.title: Build the authorize URL
steps.detail: Use https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, owner=user and an optional state.

steps.title: User approves and picks pages
steps.detail: Each customer user approves the capabilities and picks pages in the page picker. Your app only sees the pages they share.

steps.title: Exchange the code for tokens
steps.detail: POST the code to /v1/oauth/token with HTTP Basic auth. The response returns access_token, refresh_token, bot_id and workspace info.

steps.title: Enterprise admin approval
steps.detail: On Enterprise, the workspace owner approves the connection (Settings > Connections) if the workspace restricts installs.

steps.title: Draft and submit a Marketplace listing (optional)
steps.detail: Listings > Connections. Draft the listing, then submit it.
steps.agentHelp: Can draft the listing name and description, suggest a category and tags, check the name for obvious brand conflicts, and prepare the submission checklist.

steps.title: Notion reviews the listing
steps.detail: Notion reviews and replies by email within 5 to 10 business days, with approval or feedback.

submissionChecklist.item: Connection created with the "Any workspace" scope
Name with no brand or trademark conflict
OAuth flow tested end to end

gotchas.title: Installation scope is permanent
gotchas.detail: "Any workspace" vs "Selected workspaces only" can't be changed after creation. Picking the wrong one means creating a new connection, and a "Selected workspaces only" connection can never be listed.

gotchas.title: Users must share pages with the connection
gotchas.detail: Access is granted per page, not per workspace; child pages inherit access. Your app sees nothing the user didn't share. The picker only shows pages the user has full access to, and new pages aren't shared automatically unless they sit under a shared parent. This is the number one support issue.

gotchas.title: Allow without token exchange leaves no access
gotchas.detail: Clicking Allow without finishing the token exchange leaves the connection with no page access.

gotchas.title: Authorisation is per user and per workspace
gotchas.detail: Every user must authorise separately, and tokens are tied to a single workspace.

gotchas.title: Each refresh rotates both tokens
gotchas.detail: Store the new refresh token every time you refresh.

gotchas.title: Re-authorisation returns a new token pair
gotchas.detail: Since 2026-06-08, each new authorisation returns a new token pair instead of the existing token.

gotchas.title: Read expires_in instead of assuming a lifetime
gotchas.detail: The docs don't state an access-token lifetime for the REST API. Notion MCP tokens last about 8 hours.

gotchas.title: Rate limits per connection and per workspace
gotchas.detail: 180 requests per minute per connection, or 600 on Business and Enterprise plans, in a fixed 60-second window. A shared per-workspace limit applies on top. Handle 429 and 529 by honouring Retry-After; the per-workspace limit can return a Retry-After longer than 60 seconds.

gotchas.title: Payload size caps
gotchas.detail: Payloads are capped at 1,000 blocks and 500KB. Rich text is capped at 2,000 characters.

gotchas.title: API version 2026-03-11 has breaking changes
gotchas.detail: archived became in_trash, after became position, and the transcription block became meeting_notes.

gotchas.title: SDK v5+ requires API version 2025-09-03 or newer
gotchas.detail: That version splits databases into data sources.

gotchas.title: Older third-party docs list fields the current portal doesn't ask for
gotchas.detail: Make's help page lists company name, website, privacy URL, terms URL and support-email fields as part of the older form. The current Notion docs list none of them. Not confirmed either way.

blockers.symptom: Empty search results or 404s on pages
blockers.whatToDo: Prompt the user to reshare pages. You can also attach a template so Notion duplicates and shares it on install.
The customer's workspace owner adds the connection under Settings > Connections.
Read the emailed feedback, revise and resubmit.
Don't retry. API access is restricted.
